title: add RAG agent examples, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and updates to the docs site navigation. Motivation: provide a cohesive set of example playbooks and quickstarts that demonstrate RAG + tool-calling flows for new users, reduce onboarding friction, and standardize templates used by internal teams. This PR includes: checklist: - [x] RAG agent templates (markdown + example YAML configs) - [x] TypeScript and Python quickstarts showing tool-calling + streaming responses - [x] Example playbooks in redwood-examples with runnable samples - [x] Docs site navigation entry and lightweight how-to guide - [x] Unit tests for example helpers and CI docs job updates Related: Linear ENG-4021 (RAG quickstarts and doc stabilizations), PM-289 (docs prioritization). Implementation notes: - RAG templates live under docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md and include a recommended prompt structure, sample vectorstore schema, and tool definitions for search/browser/code-exec. - Examples added to redwood-examples/rag-agent-playbooks/* include a minimal TS example that uses the SDK tool-calling helpers and a Python sample that demonstrates streaming outputs and structured JSON responses. - Docs site navigation updated (docs/site/navigation.yml) and an anchor page added at docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md with embedded code snippets and links to examples. CI: added a docs smoke check and example-run CI job that runs the TS quickstart in a container to ensure no runtime regressions. Backwards compatibility: docs-only and example code; no breaking changes to public APIs. Rollout: merge to main; monitor docs-site builds and example CI for first 48 hours.
